title: Resolve the default before Model.log so the chosen format reaches artifacts, dependencies and telemetry
answers: logged model telemetry shows wrong serialization format
cloudpickle requirement missing from logged model environment
body:
Invariant: log_model must turn serialization_format into a concrete value before calling Model.log, so the same resolved format drives the saved artifact, the pip/conda dependencies and the logged-model telemetry.
Enforced in: mlflow/sklearn/__init__.py:log_model, mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py:log_model and mlflow/lightgbm/__init__.py:log_model, each resolving before the Model.log call.
What breaks if skipped: per the PR description, artifacts, dependencies and telemetry would no longer reflect the serializer actually selected (e.g. cloudpickle not recorded for a cloudpickle save).
Constraints: Resolution in save_model alone is not enough for log_model callers; both entry points need it.
applies: Any flavor log_model that forwards a defaulted serializer choice to Model.log.
says: Logged model environment requirements are missing the necessary serializer packages.
Model details show an incorrect serialization format in logged telemetry metrics.
Saved model artifacts do not match the packaging format listed in run metadata.
Ensure default model serialization formats are recorded accurately in logged dependencies.
Default serialization choices should automatically populate package requirements during model logging.
search: Model flavor log_model functions must resolve default serialization_format into a concrete value before invoking Model.log so the format flows to saved artifacts, pip/conda dependencies, and telemetry. This is enforced in mlflow/sklearn/__init__.py:log_model, mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py:log_model, and mlflow/lightgbm/__init__.py:log_model. Applies to any flavor log_model forwarding defaulted serializers; resolving within save_model alone is insufficient because log_model callers require resolution at both entry points.
